scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @expense/api" "npm run dev -w @expense/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @expense/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @expense/web
